question: Which of the following diagrams indicates the best relationship among women, mothers and dancers?
solution:
The possible Venn Diagram:

 
• Mother is always women that's why it is encircle by women.
 
• Dancer can be both women and mother that's why it is included in both the circle (women and mother).
 
• Women can be both mother and dancer that's why it is also included in both the circle (dancer and and mother).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75566045377b6149b4119150e4edb576d6f287e49ca7f49bfb4f660350948b4c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 3"**.
